chapters.label: The last minute
chapters.text: Old Trafford, 2012. The USA and Canada are tied, three-all, in the very last minute of extra time. Heather O'Reilly crosses... Alex Morgan heads it in! Four-three!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Morgan keeps running into the box. She jumps in front of the defenders and heads the ball up, over the keeper's hand.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: she aims it high, into the top corner, where the keeper can't reach.

chapters.label: Never stop
chapters.text: Keep running into the box until the very end! And aim your header where the keeper can't reach.
